description: Angular component for configuring a label-value card widget in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: LabelValueCardBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing the configuration of a label-value card widget, including form controls, validation, and configuration logic.

methods.name: displayTimewindowConfig
methods.description: Determines if the timewindow configuration should be displayed based on datasources aggregation.

methods.name: onlyHistoryTimewindow
methods.description: Checks if only comparison aggregation datasources are used, affecting timewindow options.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys, e.g., temperature, for the widget.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the configuration data from the form.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons (e.g., fullscreen) are enabled.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets card button states based on selected options.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string of the value based on current form settings.
